channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 03
item.description:
78 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Increased apartment building bounds to prevent them from being too small.
  • Deployables now check all nearby building block changes instead of only the most recent one.
  • Placing or destroying a door now refreshes only the modified door on the server, reducing unnecessary updates.

Buildings & World

  • Increased apartment building bounds to prevent them from being too small.
  • Fixed biofuel generator snapping to the wrong spot in corners with advanced snapping.

Deployables & Doors

  • Deployables now check all nearby building block changes instead of only the most recent one.
  • Placing or destroying a door now refreshes only the modified door on the server, reducing unnecessary updates.

Weapons, Loot & Combat

  • Fixed magazines staying invisible after swapping weapons mid‑reload.
  • Adjusted Uzi drops in hackable, elite, and underwater crates to avoid overlap, tweaked weight values, and added ammo to elite and underwater crates.
  • Patrol helicopter rocket kills now correctly display the helicopter on the death screen.
  • Added combat log entries when hitting gull groups.
  • Expanded the splash‑damage hitbox of triangular‑prism deployables to include grills and triangle hatches, improving damage consistency.

Player Interaction & UI

  • Players no longer get stuck in computer stations when the space behind the chair is blocked; added extra dismount points and a toast notification for refused dismounts.
  • Fixed a null‑reference error when opening the inventory screen during a phone conversation.
  • Fixed a bug where using the drop-item keybind unintentionally removed the held item from your belt while the inventory UI was open.

Vehicles & Turrets

  • Turret stock now always applies its extended properties while you are seated in a turret, regardless of how the stock was originally set.
  • Resolved a null‑reference crash in PlayerBoat.UpdateWake after rejoining a server; lingering wake effects from destroyed boats are now correctly cleared.

World Generation

  • Shore ice no longer spawns on railway tracks, preventing ice blocks on rails.
  • Roadside waterpipes will no longer appear on top of roads at T‑junctions, keeping roadways clear.

Communication

  • Phone conversation UI now shows correct information after server commands, fixing misleading text.

Combat Log

  • Combat log now displays short weapon prefab names, making kill feeds easier to read.

Steam Items

  • Steam item for Scrap King now correctly reads “upgrade to scrap king,” fixing the previous description error.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 02
item.description:
91 development commits

Transport

  • Fixed CH‑47 cargo crates getting stuck on powerline poles at the powerplant.
  • Reduced boat groups spawned at large oil rigs from two to one, easing traffic and spawn congestion.

Combat

  • PT‑boat turret aim cone widened and damage reduced, with front turret now using standard crosshair.
  • UZI now consumes double the condition per use, affecting its durability.

AI & Wildlife

  • Birds and gulls receive stronger obstacle avoidance, better walking step handling, reduced startle radius, and corpses now inherit velocity; shooting distance calculations fixed and missing seagull points added.
  • New gliding behavior, far‑range flee response, higher circling for crows, and deep‑sea gull spawning improve wildlife dynamics.

Audio & Effects

  • Splash effect timing unified across buoyancy points and minimum interval lowered, preventing audio cut‑outs during storms.

Stability

  • Fixed null reference exception when destroying phone objects, preventing crashes.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Nov 01
item.description:
3 development commits

World Generation

  • Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.

Animals & AI

  • Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.
